name: komdosh-dev-spring-delivery
description: Everything between 'a ticket exists' and 'the release PR is open'. Pulls work in from Jira, turns an architecture package into ordered agent todos, computes a lifecycle gate map from real git state and recommends the next action, and runs two-track release engineering — services get a rollback playbook, libraries get an ABI-load-bearing version bump. Never deploys, never pushes a tag, never merges a PR. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
